observations.no_token: GET /metrics on the metrics listener returned HTTP 401 JSON error code unauthorized.
observations.wrong_token: GET /metrics on the metrics listener with an incorrect synthetic bearer token returned HTTP 401 unauthorized.
observations.correct_token: GET /metrics on the metrics listener with the matching synthetic bearer token returned HTTP 200 and Prometheus text exposition, content type text/plain; version=0.0.4; charset=utf-8; escaping=underscores.
observations.exposition: The populated response included HELP, TYPE, and a data sample for tanpopo_config_snapshot_age_seconds with sync_channel="db_poll".
observations.main_listener: The app listener's /metrics path also returned 401 without auth and 200 with the correct token. It was loopback-bound during this test. Production bind/topology exposure is not inferred.
